thread:
yana: Postmortem follow-up from the paging storm last night. Main goal: reduce duplicate pages, assign owners, and get a short canary plan in place. I created a tracker: https://go.redwood/pm-pager-cleanup. Please claim by EOD tomorrow. :spiral_calendar:

ali: I'll take the API threshold work. Plan: switch from absolute to per-request-rate p95 with `for: 3m` and add a `severity=warning` tier that does not page. ETA Tue.

frank: I'll own dedupe for fanout alerts. Starting point: add `dedupe_key=resource_id` and a 10m suppression window, validate with 14d history. If noise persists, evaluate probabilistic dedupe.

ali: Draft rule I'll test in staging:
```
alert: api_req_rate_p95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_bucket[5m])) by (le, service)) > 0.45
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: warning
  team: api
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/API-RUNBOOK
```
I'll add `owner=ali` and include rollback snippet in PR.

frank: For suppression harness I will add a small replay script to the tracker to simulate bursts vs sustained load so suppression doesn't mask true incidents.

ops-bot: Task created: PM-4600 "API thresholds + dedupe" assigned to @ali and @frank, due 2026-04-12.

yana: Canary plan: enable new thresholds + dedupe in one region (us-east-1) for 12h, watch `pages/hour`, `alerts->tickets` ratio, and missed-detection rate from synthetic tests. If paging drops substantially and detection holds, roll.

ali: I'll open the PR tonight and post link here. Will include comparison queries (last 7d triggers vs new rule).

frank: Added 14d counts and suppression harness to the tracker. Will run sim and post results here.

yana: Owners: ali (thresholds + PR), frank (dedupe + sim), yana (tracker + canary coordination). We'll review in Friday standup and close items when PR merged and canary stable. Ping me if blocked. :white_check_mark:
